你是一个工作记录和用户画像提取器。从对话中提取用户的实质工作记录和个人偏好信息。

输出格式 — 必须严格遵守：
你必须且只能输出一个合法的 JSON 对象。不要输出任何其他文字、解释、问候或 markdown 代码块标记。
如果没有实质内容可记录，只输出：{"topic":"","facts":[]}

{
  "topic": "2-6个字的主题摘要",
  "facts": [
    { "tag": "done", "content": "具体描述" },
    { "tag": "discussion", "content": "具体描述" },
    { "tag": "follow-up", "content": "具体描述" },
    { "tag": "preference", "content": "具体描述" }
  ]
}

字段说明：
- topic：用 2-6 个字概括这段对话的主题（如"天气查询"、"用户信息"、"Bug修复"、"PPT制作"）
- facts：具体的记忆条目

允许的 tag 值：done / discussion / follow-up / preference

示例：

输入："今天修了 token 过期校验的 bug，还跟产品讨论了新版本方案——下周二评审"
输出：{"topic":"Bug修复与版本讨论","facts":[{"tag":"done","content":"修复了 token 过期校验缺失导致的 bug"},{"tag":"discussion","content":"新版本方案评审定在下周二"}]}

输入："帮我查一下这个报错。哦是配置写错了。明天更新一下文档"
输出：{"topic":"配置排查","facts":[{"tag":"done","content":"排查并定位到配置错误导致的问题"},{"tag":"follow-up","content":"明天更新相关文档"}]}

输入："我叫小李，在 xx公司 做运营，我们组主要负责 某某 产品推广。老板是 XXX"
输出：{"topic":"用户信息","facts":[{"tag":"preference","content":"用户名叫小李，在xx公司 做运营，所在组负责 某某 产品推广，直属上级是 XXX"}]}

输入："以后帮我做 PPT 配色用深蓝+白色的商务风，标题要简短有力"
输出：{"topic":"PPT偏好","facts":[{"tag":"preference","content":"PPT 制作偏好：深蓝+白色商务风配色，标题简短有力"}]}

输入："好的谢谢"
输出：{"topic":"","facts":[]}

输入："User: 我叫小王，在上海做设计。\nAssistant: 你好小王！\n\n---\n\nUser: 以后帮我做海报用红色主色调。\nAssistant: 记下了。"
输出：{"topic":"用户信息与设计偏好","facts":[{"tag":"preference","content":"用户名叫小王，在上海做设计"},{"tag":"preference","content":"海报设计偏好：红色主色调"}]}

提取规则：
- done：已完成的任务 / 修复的问题 / 交付的成果 / 代码变更
- discussion：技术决策 / 方案讨论 / 架构选型 / 问题分析
- follow-up：未来计划 / 待办事项 / 遗留问题
- preference：个人信息、兴趣爱好、生活方式、价值观、工作偏好、工具偏好等（如姓名、部门、喜好的新闻话题、运动、音乐、旅行风格）
- ★★ 每轮 User/Assistant 对话都必须独立检查，不要因为后面的对话而忽略前面的内容
- ★★ 用户主动提供的身份信息（姓名、公司、部门、上级等）是最高优先级，必须记录为 preference，即使 AI 已在回复中复述确认
- ★ 用户明确表达的学习需求、兴趣目标（如"想学英文"、"想学AI"）也应记录为 preference
- 只记录用户的产出和偏好，不要记录 AI 的行为或简单问答

关键要求：所有 "content" 和 "topic" 的值必须使用用户在对话中使用的语言书写。

eight blurry figures were concealed within the mist.

"Sisters, I trust everyone is already aware that Yun Jiangxian can condense Dragon Fortune ahead of schedule?"

"A matter like this, of course we know. Speaking of which, we must thank Sect Leader Ye today — she stopped Miss Tang's actions at the critical moment."

"Indeed, we truly must thank Sister Ye. Had Sister Ye not intervened, Yun Jiangxian's condensation of Dragon Fortune would likely have been delayed for several more days."

"Today, Yun Jiangxian was supposed to be mine. By speaking these words now, are you all intending to break our previous agreement?"

"Sister Menggong, don't be hasty. The eight of us sisters have gathered here for one reason alone — the Dragon Fortune within Yun Jiangxian's body. As for that dispersing Dragon Fortune, Sister may as well let it go."

"Easy for you to say!"

"Oh my, Sister White Moonlight has quite the temper today. Could it be that you're upset because His Majesty neglected you today?"

"Scented Fox, you're courting death!"

"Dear sister, then come and kill me~"

"Enough! I have no patience for your bickering! If you have grievances, settle them in private."

"Since Yun Jiangxian can condense Dragon Fortune ahead of schedule, then for these coming days, none of you are to touch the dispersing Dragon Fortune. If this drags on too long, it will inevitably draw the covetous eyes of others."

"Agreed. Sisters, let us all rest for the time being. Let it be said in advance — during this period, whoever dares violate the agreement shall be eliminated first!"

A brief silence fell over the void space.

Among the eight figures, three departed first.

Not long after, the remaining five female voices resumed their discussion.

"The matter of Yun Jiangxian condensing Dragon Fortune ahead of schedule must be kept strictly secret. The Dragon Fortune of Great Xia can only belong to one of us eight. Should any other power dare to meddle, we shall sever their claws."

"No problem. However, this must absolutely not reach Xu Xingdou's ears. She is currently guarding the border and will likely return based on the original timing of the Dragon Fortune's condensation. If we keep this secret, perhaps she won't make it back in time."

"That is good news indeed. Xu Xingdou is the last of the pro-emperor faction. If she does not interfere in this matter, we shall be spared no small amount of trouble."

"Mhm~ then it is decided."

"By the way, Sister Ye has been appearing at His Majesty's side with rather high frequency lately. If Sister has nothing pressing, perhaps keep some distance from now on."

"I'd love to~ but when His Majesty summons us, what can we humble consorts do? After all, he is still the ruler of Great Xia…"

"Sect Leader Ye has a point. The fault lies not in her frequent appearances, but in someone's insufficient charm — our Majesty can no longer be bothered to keep licking…"

"One more question — which sister advanced yesterday and drained all the spiritual energy from heaven and earth around the bedchamber?"

"No one's confessing?"

"Fine, fine~ after all, we are rivals. It's only natural to keep such matters to oneself. Farewell, sisters."

Pop.

The void space shattered and dispersed.

The five blurry figures vanished along with it.

……

Tang Menggong stood at the center of the courtyard, her entire being radiating a bone-chilling killing intent. The space around her split apart into one horrifying black fissure after another.

A retinue of sword handmaidens stood in the distance, none daring to even breathe…

"Ye Xianyue!"

"Yun Jiangxian!!"

Tang Menggong's silver teeth ground together audibly, and the murderous intent in her eyes had nearly condensed into tangible substance.

A figure flickered through the courtyard, leaves rustling noisily — and that peerless figure in white had already vanished…

The Moon Consort's bedchamber.

Qin Ran held Ye Xianyue in his arms, rather satisfied with his own performance just now.

The time remaining to condense the Dragon Fortune was running short. Facing the entire imperial harem alone, the pressure on him was truly immense.

This first step, then, was to find himself some allies.

Ye Xianyue was without a doubt the ideal target!

The goodwill he had earned yesterday in the bedchamber, combined with today's display, already counted as a fairly decent start.

From here on out, he simply needed to keep up close and intimate contact. It likely wouldn't be long before he had a chance to lure Ye Xianyue into his own camp…

Qin Ran let out a yawn.

"My beloved consort, I am rather tired today. I shall return to my quarters and rest."

Ye Xianyue gave a light nod, her bewitching and delicate face rubbing against Qin Ran's chest once more, as though with a trace of reluctance.

"Will Your Majesty come again tomorrow?"

"Mmm~ It has been a long while since I last saw Xixi. Tomorrow, I may go stroll around her place instead."

"Oh."

A faint wisp of disappointment flickered through the depths of Ye Xianyue's eyes.

Qin Ran took it all in but only smiled and said nothing.

"My beloved consort, do rest early as well."

"Mm, this consort bids Your Majesty farewell."

The two parted ways.

Leading a large retinue of eunuchs, Qin Ran ambled unsteadily back toward the imperial bedchamber.

Qing Fu walked by his side, a fawning, ingratiating smile surfacing on his gaunt face.

"Your Majesty, you seem somewhat… different today compared to days past."

Qin Ran halted his steps, turned, and dealt a solid slap squarely across Qing Fu's face.

Slap.

A dark, overcast look crossed Qing Fu's eyes, and he dropped to his knees with a thud.

"Your Majesty, spare me — this slave spoke out of turn."

A playful smile curved across Qin Ran's lips. "And now? Am I the same as days past?"

Qing Fu nodded rapidly, but on his downturned face, his expression was exceedingly ugly.

Creak.

The ancient, weathered doors of the bedchamber were pushed open.

Beside the Purple-Gold Dragon Couch, a graceful figure in white stood with her hands clasped behind her back, a hint of coldness lingering between her brows.

Qin Ran was not the least bit surprised. A smile bloomed across his face.

The worthless emperor before him was nothing more than his elder sister's bootlicker…

The dragon palanquin drew near.

Yawning, and with Qing Fu supporting him, Qin Ran hopped down with unsteady footing.

His figure lurched — he nearly stumbled and fell.

"You dog slave — is that how you support your Emperor?!"

Qin Ran planted a kick on Qing Fu. The latter's expression flickered but he dared not show any reaction.

The mocking derision at the corner of Tang Mengchen's mouth deepened.

"Yo, His Majesty has arrived. Perfect timing — I've come on my sister's behalf to fetch a few things from the treasury, but these dog slaves keep barring the gate. Quickly, have them open the doors. My sister is still waiting."

"We're all family here — easy now, easy now."

Qin Ran laughed and waved it off, sweeping his eyes over Hong Lie before his gaze finally settled on Xu Dian.

"What is your name?"

Xu Dian instinctively glanced at Tang Mengchen.

Tang Mengchen laughed. "His Majesty is speaking to you. What are you looking at me for?"

Upon hearing this, Xu Dian hastily bowed.

"In reply to Your Majesty — your subject's name is Xu Dian, with the rank of Thousand-Man Commander of the Imperial Guard, charged with overseeing the imperial treasury."

Qin Ran nodded, and with great warmth and familiarity wrapped an arm around Xu Dian's shoulder.

"Oh, so it's Commander Xu."

At this sight, Hong Lie lowered his head deeply.

The despair in his heart had already swallowed him whole.

Xu Dian secretly let out a breath of relief.

Qin Ran pointed at Hong Lie and said offhandedly, "Those wounds on him — you were the one who taught him that lesson?"
